Patch src/cards/transaction.ts (its current text follows) and return it WHOLE: add `export interface TestLines { failLine: string | null; locationLine: string | null; packageLine: string | null }` next to Blame, and give blameLog a sixth parameter `testLines: readonly TestLines[] = []` with the behaviour of Blame Log below: indented lines and lines no fileLine matched go to the testLines patterns; a bare location name is joined to the package of the first packageLine match on a LATER line (else the last earlier one); candidates are the path without a leading "/" and then with its leading segments dropped one at a time, walked to the first owned (blame its owner) or existing (blame nothing); none: a relative path blames card, an absolute one nothing; at the end, nothing blamed and nothing outside → cards [] when some testLines pattern matched, else [card]. With testLines [] every result is exactly main's. TRANSACTION_MARK, isTransactionDeck and Blame are unchanged; keep `import type { Card } from "./types.js"` as the only import. Pure: no process, no console, no file read, no node: module; the inputs are never changed. Write no test file: a probe tests you and a judge writes the example tests.

## Function Transaction Deck

The mark an --only cut puts on every acceptance, and the test whether a deck carries it.

Behaviour: src/cards/transaction.ts (P21c, issue #12), pure, no import but the Card type: `export const TRANSACTION_MARK = "# morph: subset transaction"` (a shell comment line) and isTransactionDeck(cards) — true when some card's acceptance is a string starting with TRANSACTION_MARK + "\n", else false (an empty list included). The mark is written by Build Acceptances for an --only cut and read by Run Deck (the deck runs as one transaction) and Stub Trees (the tree of the whole subset).

Steps:
- reads: Card

Examples (the tests must prove each one):
1. given cards [a with acceptance TRANSACTION_MARK + "\nexit 0", b with acceptance null]; then [a "exit 0", b null]; then []; when isTransactionDeck; then true; false; false
2. given one card whose acceptance is TRANSACTION_MARK alone (no newline); then " " + TRANSACTION_MARK + "\nexit 0"; then "exit 0\n" + TRANSACTION_MARK + "\n"; when isTransactionDeck; then false; false; false (only a first line equal to the mark counts)

Data Card: One unit of work for an executor; what morph run compiles into a request.
Schema:
{
  "customId": "string, ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$",
  "intent": "'generate' | 'patch'",
  "targets": "string[] non-empty, repo-relative, distinct after normalisation",
  "contextSlice": "string[] default []",
  "instruction": "string non-empty",
  "acceptance": "string | null — a shell command run from the repo root",
  "model": "string | null",
  "maxTokens": "number | null",
  "reasoning": "{ maxTokens: number } | { effort: 'low'|'medium'|'high' } | null",
  "variants": "number >= 1, default 1",
  "dependsOn": "string[] default []"
}

## Function Blame Log

The cards a red acceptance log blames by the files its lines name, and the lines naming files outside them.

Behaviour: blameLog(log, card, owners, fileLines, exists, testLines = []) in src/cards/transaction.ts, pure: log the red acceptance's output; card the customId whose acceptance it is; owners a Record target path → owning customId; fileLines regular-expression sources (Tree Profiles' fileLine, in order: group 1 the path, group 2 the rest); exists(path) whether the path is on disk; testLines (P24c, issue #19) the Test Lines of Tree Profiles' TEST_LINES in order, each {failLine, locationLine, packageLine}, a regular-expression source or null, group 1 of each the path. `export interface TestLines { failLine: string | null; locationLine: string | null; packageLine: string | null }` lives in src/cards/transaction.ts next to Blame. For every line of log.split("\n"), its trailing white space removed (trimEnd): a line that is "" or starts with "#" is skipped. A line that does not start with " " or "\t" goes to fileLines first: the FIRST of fileLines that matches it (new RegExp, in order) gives p = group 1 and rest = group 2; p an own key of owners → owners[p] is blamed; else exists(p) false → card is blamed (a file of the acceptance itself, gone when it ends: a probe); else p + rest is an outside line. A line no fileLine matched (an indented line always) goes to testLines: the first pattern that matches it, entry by entry in order and in each entry failLine, then locationLine, then packageLine (null ones skipped). A packageLine match blames nothing: its group 1 is the package of the bare file names around it. A failLine or locationLine match gives P = group 1, resolved as follows. (1) A P with no "/" from a locationLine is joined to its package: K + "/" + P, K = group 1 of the first packageLine match on a LATER line of the log (go test prints a package's failures before its FAIL line), else of the last one on an earlier line; no packageLine match anywhere → P as it is. (2) The candidates: P without a leading "/", then the same with its leading path segments dropped one at a time ("m/a/b_test.go", "a/b_test.go", "b_test.go"). (3) The candidates are walked in order to the first that is an own key of owners (→ that owner is blamed) or that exists (→ nothing: a file no card owns; a test line is never an outside line). (4) No candidate owned or existing → card is blamed when P does not start with "/" (a file of the acceptance itself, gone: a probe), nothing when it does (a frame of the toolchain). After the walk, no card blamed and no outside line: some line matched a pattern of testLines → no card is blamed (an unattributed red, Blame {cards: [], outside: []}; P24c, issue #19 item 2: a red nobody owns does not blame every card that saw it); else → card is blamed (a red naming no file: a guard, a message). → Blame {cards: the blamed ids, outside: the outside lines}, each once, sorted (JavaScript's default sort). The inputs are never changed. testLines [] (the default) gives the result before P24c: no indented line is read.

Steps:
- produces: Blame

Schema:
{ cards: string[]; outside: string[] } — both sorted, each entry once

## Component requirements / guardrails

Requirements:
- Strict TypeScript: tsconfig strict, ESM, no `any`; every module compiles with tsc --noEmit.
- One Document Out: Every command prints exactly one JSON document on stdout and nothing else; the human log goes to stderr.
- Deterministic Core: cards and compiler give byte-identical results for the same inputs: no clock, no randomness, no environment reads. acceptance is bound only in its pure parts (Snapshot Targets, Build Attempt Diff): Run Acceptance spawns a shell and its only timer is the child's timeout; env and the timeout are parameters, never process.env (06.10, P3). processor reads the environment only in Read Registry; Assemble Request, Read Response, Stub Answer, Assemble Batch and Read Batch are pure of clock and network; the transport and its sleep are parameters of Send Generation and Send Batch (P4, P11). git spawns only in Run Git, synchronously, with the child's environment given whole as a parameter; it reads no process.env and no clock of its own (P6). cli touches the process only in its entry src/cli.ts: the environment, the working directory, the clock and the output streams reach main() as parameters, and the environment reaches the processor only through Read Registry (P7). language is pure data and pure functions: no clock, no environment, no file system, no child process; node:path is its only Node module; its shell lines are text (P8). contour reads no file, no clock and no environment: it parses the text it is given; the package yaml is imported in Parse Document alone (P9). planner reads no file, no clock and no environment: the cli reads the record and the map and passes which files exist as a function; node:path is its only Node module (P10a). builder reads no file, no clock and no environment: the caller passes the checks, the cards, the profile and the texts of the guard, the locator and the probes; node:path is its only Node module (P10b). primer reads files and spawns git (git's gitOk, the environment a parameter) only in Primer Command, the clock only there through deps.now; Read Runs, Read Story and Render Primer are pure functions of what they are given, no network anywhere (P12a). scout reads no clock, no environment and no network and spawns nothing: Parse Turn, Spend Budget and Seed From Ownership are pure; Cage Path and Run Tool reach the file system only through the ScoutFs parameter (realpath, readFile); elapsed time is a parameter; node:path is its only Node module (P13a). scout-session reaches the model only through the processor's Send Generation and the clock only through deps.now; Run Scout reads the tree through the ScoutFs parameter; Scout Command and Plan From Scout are the scout layer's two node:fs files (git through gitOk and runGit, node:crypto for the sha256 in Scout Command), the environment a parameter (P13b). reviewer's checks (Find Obligations, Check Envelope, Check Guardrails, Plan Mutants, Render Findings) are pure functions of the record, git's outputs and the texts they are given: no file, no clock, no environment, no child process, no Node module (P14a). review-session spawns only through acceptance's Run Acceptance (the mutant runs, each under its timeout) and git's Run Git; Run Mutants writes only through acceptance's Restore Snapshot; Review Command is the reviewer layer's one node:fs file (the record, the map and scout.json read, the review written), the environment a parameter, no clock and no model call (P14b). debt spawns only through acceptance's Run Acceptance and git's Run Git, reads the deck file, the card's files and the run archive through node:fs, no clock and no model call; the environment is a parameter (P17). scaffold reads the template folders and writes the new project through node:fs (node:url only to find the package root from its own module file), spawns nothing, reads no clock and no environment (P18).
- Node Only: Runtime dependencies: Node 20 built-ins and the package `yaml` (the record reader), nothing else; dev dependencies pinned exactly, no ^ or ~.

Guardrails:
- No Network In Tests: tests/setup.ts makes fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket and net.connect throw "network blocked in tests"; only the processor's own transport is mocked.
- No Shell Outside Acceptance: child processes are spawned only by Run Acceptance, the git module (in Run Git alone, P6) and the processor's none; everything else is pure.
- Frozen Tree During Run: while a run is in flight no file outside the cards' targets and .morph/ changes; a changed declared input discards the answer unread.

Tests are vitest: `toBe` on scalars and short strings, `toStrictEqual` on a whole result; stubs come from `tests/helpers.ts`, never your own.

## Function Tree Profiles

Per language, how deck check compiles a stub tree and how a file:line line of its tools reads.

Behaviour: src/language/treeProfiles.ts: TREE_PROFILES, one Tree Profile per profile of PROFILES, in the same order, pure data; treeProfileFor(id) → the entry with that id, else null. The strings below are JavaScript string literals. typescript: config "tsconfig.card.json", command "node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p {config}", fileLine "^(\\S+?\\.tsx?)(\\(\\d+,\\d+\\).*)$"; python: config null, command null (no compile or typecheck step), fileLine "^(\\S+?\\.pyi?)(:\\d+.*)$"; go: config "full.json", command "go build -overlay {config} ./... ; go vet -overlay {config} ./...", fileLine "^(?:vet: )?(?:\\./)?(\\S+?\\.go)(:\\d+.*)$". config is the file a card's acceptance writes into $P that sets what its compile stage sees; {config} is that file's path; group 1 of fileLine is the file, group 2 the rest of the line from the position on. Text only, never run here. TEST_LINES (P24c, issue #19): `export const TEST_LINES: readonly TestProfile[]`, `export interface TestProfile { id: string; failLine: string | null; locationLine: string | null; packageLine: string | null }`, one per profile of PROFILES in the same order, pure data (no import), read by Blame Log: failLine a line naming a failing test file, locationLine a failure's location line (any indent), packageLine a line naming the package of a test failure; group 1 of each the path. typescript: failLine "^\\s*FAIL\\s+(\\S+?\\.[cm]?[jt]sx?)(?:\\s|$)", locationLine "^\\s+\\u276f\\s+(?:\\S+\\s+)?(\\S+?\\.[cm]?[jt]sx?):\\d+:\\d+", packageLine null; python: failLine "^(?:FAILED|ERROR) (\\S+?\\.pyi?)(?:::|\\s|$)", locationLine null (pytest prints its locations at column 0: fileLine reads them), packageLine null; go: failLine null, locationLine "^\\s+(\\S+?\\.go):\\d+", packageLine "^FAIL\\t(\\S+)". TREE_PROFILES and treeProfileFor are unchanged.

Steps:
- produces: Tree Profile

Examples (the tests must prove each one):
1. given treeProfileFor("typescript"), treeProfileFor("python"), treeProfileFor("go"), treeProfileFor("rust"); when looked up; then the three entries as the behavior writes them, each id equal to a PROFILES id in the same order; then null
2. given new RegExp(each fileLine) on "src/a/b.ts(12,5): error TS2304: x", "vet: ./pkg/q.go:3:7: y", "pkg/q.go:3: z", "tests/test_a.py:9: AssertionError", " src/a.ts(1,1): continuation"; when matched; then typescript: ["src/a/b.ts", "(12,5): error TS2304: x"] on the first only; go: ["pkg/q.go", ":3:7: y"] and ["pkg/q.go", ":3: z"]; python: ["tests/test_a.py", ":9: AssertionError"]; no fileLine matches the indented line
3. given TEST_LINES; when read; then three entries, ids "typescript", "python", "go" (PROFILES order), each string exactly as the behavior writes it
4. given new RegExp(each non-null pattern of TEST_LINES) on " FAIL tests/units/len.test.ts > one metre", " ❯ tests/units/len.test.ts:4:21", " ❯ toFeet src/units/len.ts:2:25", "FAILED tests/test_calc.py::test_half - assert 2 == 4", " daemon_examples_test.go:16: OnExit:", "\t/tmp/morphlite/daemon/daemon_examples_test.go:22 +0x2", "FAIL\tmorphlite/daemon\t0.004s", "FAIL", "--- FAIL: TestDaemonCoreExample2 (0.00s)"; when matched; then group 1: typescript failLine "tests/units/len.test.ts" on the first only; typescript locationLine "tests/units/len.test.ts" and "src/units/len.ts" on the second and third only; python failLine "tests/test_calc.py" on the fourth only; go locationLine "daemon_examples_test.go" and "/tmp/morphlite/daemon/daemon_examples_test.go" on the fifth and sixth only; go packageLine "morphlite/daemon" on the seventh only; nothing matches "FAIL" or the "--- FAIL" line
